exposure: Group B Streptococcus screening and treatment guidelines
different provider types (obstetrics and gynecology, certified nurse midwives, and family medicine)
cohort: All prenatal care and delivery patients at a single institution in a single year
finding: Adherence to Group B Streptococcus screening and treatment guidelines in pregnancy was high (89%) and did not differ significantly by maternal age, race, provider type, delivery mode, or gestational age at delivery.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was recorded but not specified
